data.notes: The report gets the core story right. It names the payback request a month before the freeze as the turning point, reports the revenue framing as pushed back, and builds messaging changes around a customer-specific cost of doing nothing. However, it uses Value proof as the tag instead of No decision. It also never cites or labels the rep's 'It's timing... nothing we could have done' as opinion, only challenging it in prose. The close omits the cost of the homegrown system as the uncovered question and the renewal-season follow-up, and it treats migration as a co-loss reason rather than a next-cycle risk.
